name: Analyze Fertility
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, paladin 1, ranger 1, hedge witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Through casting this spell, you gain instant insight into the reproductive capabilities of the target. You can identify problems such as impotence, sterility, or infertility, and can determine when a female is most fertile. The spell also reveals if the subject is under the influences of any magical or herbal means of blocking conception.
